name: rot-moe
description: RoT MoE - a nine-lens Mixture-of-Experts router with a measured R/s+ divergence gauge, specified in Lean 4 and bound to the shipped hooks by an executable checker. 627 machine-checked theorems, zero sorry, kernel re-verified.

plugins.name: rot-moe
plugins.description: Nine-lens MoE router for Claude Code. One UserPromptSubmit hook picks a lane from your prompt and prints one line before the turn; the model decides everything after that. No network, no API key, no Lean toolchain required. The routing table it uses is the one specified in Lean 4 and re-checked by the kernel.
